summary: REQ-1–REQ-3 appear to be implemented (gross totals per golfer, manual golfer-count numeric input with 1–64 validation, and blank-by-default tournament title with no forced fallback on submit). REQ-4 is partially evidenced (leaderboard omits empty title heading; PDF export introduces a metadata fallback title), but the diff excerpt for the PDF HTML is truncated so conditional omission of an on-page empty title line cannot be fully verified. The diff also appears to introduce a Callaway scoring logic change, which is explicitly a non-goal.

hallucinated_features.description: Modified Callaway calculation rule: when gross score is at or below course par, net score equals gross score (no deduction/adjustment).
